arguments.literal: Complete consumer update mutation requires explicit acceptance of the exact presented plan and rederivation of that plan. Possession of its digest alone grants no operation authority. Existing adopt, sync and fleet contracts retain their narrower boundaries; their authorization cannot be widened merely because the complete-update operation exists.

Where an owner ruling exists or is required, recover its original applicable scope once. This conditional relation does not add a new universal owner-ruling requirement; complete-update operation authority and exact plan acceptance still come from the owning contract.

For each selected derived context, missing, ambiguous, changed or unavailable program/map/source evidence holds the complete update before consumer effects. Its source owner supplies any necessary semantic re-entry; the manager cannot mechanically relabel an older map as current. Exact source freshness supplies integrity evidence, not semantic conformance or an independent semantic verdict.

The separate cohort-update operation presents the whole plan without consumer effects. Its acceptance object binds physical effect destinations and binding preimages, exact selected cohort bytes, companion annotated tags/commits/subtrees and inventories, replacement dependency locators, native routes and declared derived-source observations under the same canonical JSON hashing rule as the Adoption Plan. Already-installed status adds no authority and does not change the plan digest.

A Complete Consumer Update Plan binds one explicitly selected Product Definition and the complete companion population of one exact release-matched cohort to the invocation-owner-selected consumer bindings. The Product Definition owns composition; the cohort and each Product release record own release and member identity. The caller selects every native route and derived context in the claimed update scope. Proximity or empty discovery supplies no selection; an empty derived-context population means the owner selected none, not that semantic context is absent. Invocation selection and its plan/result are operation evidence, not a new persistent dependency declaration, registry or lock.

Before reliance, the complete update verifies the selected cohort dependency closure and each exact companion definition, release record and admitted members. It stages absent immutable installs, verifies existing installs without repairing them in place, and preflights every consumer target. Only the selected basis/schema, existing composition locators/contracts and selected native/install links may change. Historical installs and unrelated consumer content remain available and unchanged. The operation creates no consumer-local checker and changes no Product meaning or local semantic map.

C records reproducible facts and sufficient declared rule application; J records only unresolved semantics or materiality; O remains a ruling of its actual owner. None creates operation, admission or decision authority or a new calculus kind.

After checking exact applicability, reuse valid C across roles, conversations and resumptions. Changed request, candidate, basis, owner/root, projection, accepted trace, rule, configuration or material evidence invalidates affected claims before reliance. Retain predecessor/successor identities, changed inputs, surviving facts and affected J dependencies; recompute the wider frontier where independence is unproved.

Apply only owner-declared rules with sufficient facts; record owners, matched predicates and consequences for smallest lawful re-entry, next action, evidence/assessment, reserved ruling and carrier lifetime. Keep conflicting rules or missing premises unresolved. A label or filename cannot select treatment, and a rule-settled question needs no invented J.

Retain a direct or lawful-proxy ruling in original wording with owner, exact subject/basis, permitted scope/effects, conditions and source, separate from interpretation. Consume sufficient existing authority while applicable without requesting it again. Only a materially changed or newly ambiguous decision returns its affected question to the owner; a record creates no extra authority or registry.

One capable context with sufficient existing work authority, exact intake and operation grant may construct directly when the applicable configuration permits. Coordinate material context, authority, capability or independence needs; role/frame names alone create none. Preserve admission, smallest lawful carrier, required assessment, reserved decisions and result consumer. Sufficient direct work adds no Executive appointment, review, ticket or diagram recreation merely to finish.

Sufficient declared treatment supports the settled direct branch. Unknown treatment holds dependent reliance, while an exact existing evidence or construction grant may still authorize the bounded discriminator or first candidate. Recover O only where it exists or is required, without widening its original scope or demanding a new ruling merely for this branch.

Withhold reliance or promotion that depends on unknown treatment. An existing exact construction/evidence grant may permit a bounded discriminator, including the first candidate, with its own subject, territory, operations and stops. Update affected C before dependent reliance; unrelated authorized work remains permitted. Obtaining candidate bytes is not conformance or admission.

Existing adopt, sync and fleet contracts retain their narrower boundaries; their authorization cannot be widened merely because the complete-update operation exists.

frame_indexes.scope: Construct and self-validate an isolated complete-consumer-update candidate only under the exact existing construction grant and selected subject. Preserve the sufficient direct branch and the declared return relation, first to Executive when coordinated. Unknown treatment holds dependent reliance without cancelling separately authorized bounded evidence or first-candidate construction. Candidate readiness supplies no acceptance, independent verdict, actual consumer/fleet operation or enlarged owner authority.

residuals.detail: This program supplies no invocation-specific consumer selection, accepted complete update plan, companion verification, derived-source observation or observed application result. Obtain these from their actual invocation, source and effect owners. Empty selection does not establish absence; a valid plan digest does not grant effects; source integrity does not settle semantic sufficiency; unknown or unrecovered effects cannot support a complete-update claim.
The full standards and their digest-bound compressions overlap. This program preserves both routes but does not claim that the compression is sufficient for every future question.
Frame references orient this authoring run; they do not constitute Product adoption, an activation packet, role assignment, or GTL composition.

The Axiom Indexer MVP schema is an a_c.text authoring contract and does not encode the complete admitted M_b populations, exact external resolution set, transformations, traversals, or judgments required by the full calculus.

No task-specific outcome judgment, effect state or retry rule is established by this program. Use the original work outcome, effect-owner evidence/rule and any applicable recorded semantic judgment. Invalidation may remove support for composite satisfaction without reversing an independently valid explanation judgment or prescribing the opposite immediate retry action.

This program indexes source-grounded constraints and routes. It does not select an activation, construct a universal prompt engine, prescribe one solution, or close realization choices that are not material to the activated evaluation.

The program cannot infer missing rule precedence, intended target meaning, governing insufficiency or reserved authority from a changed candidate. Preserve the conflicting premises and exact affected owner/frontier; obtain only the supported residual judgment or ruling needed for dependent treatment.
Deterministic validation establishes declared structure and URI resolution only. No competent semantic acceptance judgment establishes completeness, fidelity, truth, or unique interpretation.

This working semantic construction binds the exact 52-member source snapshot containing the reviewed T030 and T029 source relations plus the bootstrap SPEC-digest correction. It authors the explicitly selected conditional Worker and Reviewer frame indexes and source-grounded supporting clause references using the exact Axiom projection candidate. Mechanical views do not supply independent semantic comparison or native-use qualification. The selected final successor cut, release-scoped rebinding, matching dependency construction, final native qualification and adoption remain separate outstanding relations. This is no released or adopted successor, installed authority, semantic acceptance, or complete final delivery.

This compression states source rules but supplies no task-specific authority graph, Public serializer, accepted-design trace producer or automatic treatment classifier. The actual source/worksite/proof owner must supply sufficient exact C; unavailable mappings or effects remain unknown and block only dependent claims.

Frame URIs and available evaluators are not a complete task-specific obligation inventory. Obtain the actual owners predicates, sufficient premises, required-result identities, conjunction and independence rules; unknown applicability or an absent exact required result remains unresolved.
